image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a vintage typewriter keyboard. The focus is on the bottom row of keys, specifically highlighting the long, cream-colored space bar at the very bottom center. Above it are rows of round, black typewriter keys with white characters. The body of the typewriter is a muted sage green or grey metal. The background is a plain, out-of-focus off-white wall.
